name: Potter Webster Company
old_description: Locally owned and nationally known, Potter Webster is proud to be your parts supplier and we strive every day to be the best at what we do. As a family owned business since 1940, we have worked hard to bring quality parts and service to our industry. With the support of our loyal customers, we now house over 120 product lines in our 51,000 square ft Portland warehouse; this means we’ll have the parts you need when you need them. Our mission is to keep your vehicles safely on the road and making you money. Value is what Potter Webster Company is all about. about:
Potter Webster Company has operated from Portland, Oregon since 1940 as a family-owned business. The company began as a local parts supplier and has grown into a nationally recognized distributor while maintaining its original ownership structure.

The company stocks more than 120 product lines across a 51,000-square-foot warehouse, covering categories from brake and suspension components to hydraulic systems, driveline parts, and trailer accessories. In addition to distribution, Potter Webster runs a service shop that performs light trailer repairs, machine-shop work, fan-clutch rebuilding, brake-shoe relining, U-bolt bending, and custom cable assembly.

Customers include commercial fleets, independent repair shops, and trailer operators across the heavy-duty truck and trailer aftermarket. The catalog features brands such as Hendrickson trailer axle components, Denso starters and alternators under the Power Edge label, and Cobra winch bars, reflecting a focus on Class 4–8 vehicles and related equipment.

Management describes the mission as keeping vehicles safely on the road and profitable for their owners, emphasizing a value-driven approach built on understanding customer needs. The combination of deep local inventory and in-house repair capabilities is presented as the foundation of their market reputation.
